en:
Weren't you watching, Shuichi? The piranhas
were dropped into the tank from above.

If they had been in the tank from the
start, they woulda gobbled up Himiko.

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

Huuuuh? But Ryoma was chomped up
by the piranhas, right?

You'll need better evidence than that
to make me think otherwise.

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

See? Shuichi agrees with me...
It wasn't a trick, it was...magic.

Why are you messin' around, man?
Get your head on straight!

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma's body was eaten by the
piranhas that fell into the tank...

<CLT=cltMIND>but I don't think that was the
cause of death! And I'll prove it!

<CLT=cltMIND>Ryoma's body was eaten by the
piranhas that fell into the tank...

<CLT=cltMIND>That is a fact, but that doesn't
mean it was the cause of death...
